name: memory_forget
description: Explicitly forget a memory by ID. The memory is tombstoned (logical deletion): it becomes invisible to recall, inspect and export, but its content bytes REMAIN on disk and in any backup or snapshot. This is not erasure. Use memory_purge when the data itself must be physically destroyed.

memory_id.description: The ID of the memory to forget.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.
